comment: Although the REDDHI framework and the STAC foundation are the most valuable part of the document, they are not given the prominence they deserve, and the capabilities/components and DPI-H architecture design tables need more explanation than they currently carry for a clinical reader to interpret them.

public.text: Although the REDDHI framework and the STAC foundation are the most valuable part of the document, they are not given the prominence they deserve, and the capabilities/components and DPI-H architecture design tables need more explanation than they currently carry for a clinical reader to interpret them.
public.suggestedRevision: Call out REDDHI and the STAC foundation explicitly in the executive summary, and expand the explanatory text accompanying the capabilities/components table and the DPI-H architecture design table so a clinical reader can interpret them without external help.
